bibliographic_record.title: Synchronization and resilience in the Kuramoto white matter network model with adaptive state-dependent delays

verbatim_excerpt: J. Math. Neurosci. 10, article 16 (2020), open access, published 16 September 2020. '...we modified the canonical Kuramoto model by enabling all connections with adaptive, phase-dependent delays... plastic delays act as a stabilizing mechanism promoting the network's ability to maintain synchronous activity... global synchronization is more resilient to perturbations and injury towards network architecture.'
